name: douluo_dalu
description: Douluo Dalu and related xianxia/xuanhuan fanfiction: cultivation ranks, martial souls, soul beasts, professions, theories, a multilingual termbase and strict Pinyin romanization (Zero-CJK outside Sources).
features: Martial soul, soul beast, profession and theory note types
Spirit ring and bone progression tracking
Termbase seed with rank ladder, refinement stages, es/pt-BR columns and a Spirit/Soul variant table

provenance.notes: Derived from the author's Douluo vaults. English spellings follow Fandom captures; es and pt-BR terms are proposals. The two reference vault families disagree on rank titles (Spirit vs Soul) and on the shape of wuhun (list vs dict); both are documented, neither is imposed. Provenance properties (canon_status, source_refs, evidence_*) now live in the framework baseline.

sources.title: Author's reference vaults (Fanfictions / Fanfiction collections), surveyed during the SPEC-009 audit
